pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: world GK (newspapers of the world)

patterns: APPSC asks first Telugu newspaper (Satyadoota) and paper-founder pairs (Krishna Patrika-Konda Venkatappayya, Andhra Patrika-Kasinathuni, Swarajya-Gadicherla).
'Identify the wrong match' shape is common: Andhra Prakasika is A.P. Parthasarathy Naidu's, not Anandacharlu's.
Mutnuri Krishna Rao as most famous Krishna Patrika editor; Andhra Mata for Home Rule; Swarajya name confusion with Prakasam's English paper.
App MCQs mirror PYQ shapes well; some go into minor journals (Purushartha Pradayini, Tattvabodhini) beyond PYQ depth.
